{{ElectionsOH}}

The '''2006 Ohio Secretary of State election''' was held on November 7, 2006, to elect the [[Ohio Secretary of State]], concurrently with elections to the [[2006 United States Senate election in Ohio|United States Senate]], [[2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio|U.S. House of Representatives]], [[2006 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor]], and other state and [[2006 United States elections#Local elections|local]] elections, as part of the [[2006 United States elections|2006 midterm elections]]. Primary elections were held on May 2, 2006, though both major party candidates ran uncontested.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Primary Election: May 2, 2006 |url=https://www.ohiosos.gov/elections/election-results-and-data/2006-elections-results/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=Ohio Secretary of State}}</ref> A debate was hosted by the [[League of Women Voters]] and [[Ohio News Network]] on October 19, 2006.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 19, 2006 |title=Race for Ohio Secretary of State is Civil |url=https://www.wosu.org/news/2006-10-19/race-for-ohio-secretary-of-state-is-civil |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=WOSU 89.7}}</ref>

Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] secretary [[Ken Blackwell]] was term-limited and instead was the unsuccessful Republican nominee for [[2006 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=November 10, 2006 |title=After years of red majority, blue tidal wave inundates GOP |url=https://www.the-daily-record.com/story/news/2006/11/11/after-years-red-majority-blue/19636812007/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=The Daily Record}}</ref> [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[Franklin County, Ohio|Franklin County]] Common Pleas judge [[Jennifer Brunner]] defeated Republican [[Hamilton County, Ohio|Hamilton County]] judge Greg Hartmann in the general election.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Drew |first1=James |last2=Eder |first2=Steve |date=November 8, 2006 |title=Strickland easily takes Ohio governor job |url=https://www.toledoblade.com/local/politics/2006/11/08/Strickland-easily-takes-Ohio-governor-job/stories/200611080073 |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=The Blade}}</ref> Prior to the election, Hartmann was involved in a controversy regarding [[Social Security number|Social Security numbers]] being public and leaked in Hamilton County, which was brought up during a debate between him and Brunner.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 27, 2006 |title=Secretary of State Candidates Debate at City Club |url=https://www.ideastream.org/2006-10-27/secretary-of-state-candidates-debate-at-city-club |access-date=September 14, 2025 |website=Ideastream Public Media}}</ref> Brunner became the first woman to be elected as Ohio Secretary of State.<ref name="firstfemale" />
